name: A Mermaid's Heart
source:
They told you she drowned, but it makes no sense. She might still be out there somewhere. Thankfully, you have a way to find out. Explore two routes and six different endings to the story!

This is a short narrative horror game about a missing sister, creepy mermaids, and a really, really deep lake.

[From [url=https://nightsparrow.itch.io/a-mermaids-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他们告诉你，你的姐妹溺水身亡了，可这根本说不通。她也许还在某个地方。幸好，你有办法查明真相。探索故事中的两条路线与六种不同结局！

这是一款短篇叙事恐怖游戏，讲述失踪的姐妹、令人毛骨悚然的美人鱼，以及一片深不见底的湖泊。

[摘自[url=https://nightsparrow.itch.io/a-mermaids-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
